title: Star Ferry
description: This Resourcepack Adds The Star Ferry Model From Hong Kong And Is Great For An Mtr World/Server
body:
This resourcepack contains the star ferry model as seen in Hong Kong.
This resourcepack requires MTR 4.0.4 or later.
To use the resourcepack make a boat line and in the boat dashboard, select the star ferry boat. And enjoy.
Boat Lenth is 32.

Model by chrisw
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/star-ferry-7b0f363137e94d688db63da2b4e0b376

Texture and model files were changed to adapt to Minecraft's formatting
